[[File:Ropagi_II.png|right|thumb|Ropagi II's planetary profile, The Southern Ocean on the right.]]
The '''Southern Ropaga Ocean''' was one of the main oceans located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ropagi II]]. It was situated on the western hemisphere, south of the continent [[Afterthought]].<ref name="TSK51">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>
